# Radio (AzuraCast)

The Neuro 21 Station radio runs on AzuraCast, so some public AzuraCast endpoints are also available. They need no API key. Always use `neuro_21` as the station ID.

## Streams

| Format | URL |
| --- | --- |
| MP3 320 kbps | `https://radio.twinskaraoke.com/listen/neuro_21/radio.mp3` |
| Opus 128 kbps | `https://radio.twinskaraoke.com/listen/neuro_21/radio.ogg` |
| HLS | `https://radio.twinskaraoke.com/hls/neuro_21/live.m3u8` |

### HTTP only

`radio.twinskaraoke.com` is proxied by Cloudflare, so it requires HTTPS. If your player only supports HTTP (some games do), use `direct-radio.twinskaraoke.com` with the same paths.

| Format | URL |
| --- | --- |
| MP3 320 kbps | `http://direct-radio.twinskaraoke.com/listen/neuro_21/radio.mp3` |
| Opus 128 kbps | `http://direct-radio.twinskaraoke.com/listen/neuro_21/radio.ogg` |
| HLS | `http://direct-radio.twinskaraoke.com/hls/neuro_21/live.m3u8` |

Now playing data updates every few seconds. Poll no more than once every 15 seconds.

Base URL: https://radio.twinskaraoke.com

## Now playing

The current song, the next song and recent history.

### `GET /api/nowplaying/{station_id}` — Get now playing

Auth: none

Returns the current song with elapsed and remaining time, the next song, the last few songs played and listener counts.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `station_id` | path | `string` | yes | Always `neuro_21`. |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  station: {
    id: int
    name: string
    shortcode: string
    description: string
    timezone: string
    listen_url: string  // MP3 stream URL.
    hls_url: string | null  // HLS stream URL.
    public_player_url: string
    requests_enabled: bool
    is_public: bool
  }
  listeners: {
    current: int
    unique: int
    total: int
  }
  now_playing: {
    sh_id: int  // History entry ID.
    played_at: int  // Unix timestamp in seconds.
    duration: int  // Length in seconds.
    playlist: string  // The rotation playlist the song came from.
    is_request: bool  // Whether a listener requested the song.
    elapsed: int  // Seconds played so far. Only on `now_playing`.
    remaining: int  // Seconds left. Only on `now_playing`.
    song: {
      id: string  // AzuraCast song hash.
      text: string  // `Artist - Title`.
      artist: string
      title: string
      album: string
      art: string  // Cover art URL.
      custom_fields: {
        songId: string
      }  // `songId` is the song's ID in the main API, usable with `GET /api/songs/{id}`.
    }
  }
  playing_next: { …same as `now_playing` above }
  song_history: { …same as `now_playing` above }[]
  is_online: bool
}
```

## Song requests

Songs listeners can request, and submitting a request.

### `GET /api/station/{station_id}/requests` — List requestable songs

Auth: none

Returns a page of songs that can be requested. Use `request_id` from a row to submit a request.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `station_id` | path | `string` | yes | Always `neuro_21`. |
| `current` | query | `int` | no | Page number, starting at 1. |
| `rowCount` | query | `int` | no | Rows per page. |
| `searchPhrase` | query | `string` | no | Filters by title or artist. |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  page: int
  per_page: int
  total: int
  total_pages: int
  rows: {
    request_id: string
    request_url: string  // Path to POST to for this song.
    song: {
      id: string  // AzuraCast song hash.
      text: string  // `Artist - Title`.
      artist: string
      title: string
      album: string
      art: string  // Cover art URL.
      custom_fields: {
        songId: string
      }  // `songId` is the song's ID in the main API, usable with `GET /api/songs/{id}`.
    }
  }[]
}
```

### `POST /api/station/{station_id}/request/{request_id}` — Request a song

Auth: none

Adds a song to the request queue. AzuraCast limits how often one listener can request and refuses songs that played recently. Both return an error message.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `station_id` | path | `string` | yes | Always `neuro_21`. |
| `request_id` | path | `string` | yes | `request_id` from the requestable songs list. |

Response `200` The request was accepted.

Response `400` The request was refused. The body explains why.
